post.summary: Initiates the password recovery process for a user based on the provided recovery command.

requestBody.description: An object containing the information required to request password recovery. Must not be null.

200.description:
An IActionResult indicating the result of the password recovery request. Returns 200 OK if the request is
    successful; otherwise, returns 400 Bad Request with an error message.

post.summary: Resets the user's password using the provided reset token and new password.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description:
The password reset token associated with the user. This value is typically provided to the user via email and
    must be valid and unexpired.

parameters.name: newPassword
parameters.description: The new password to set for the user. Must meet the application's password requirements.

200.description: An IActionResult indicating the result of the password reset operation. Returns OkResult if the password was reset successfully; otherwise, returns BadRequestObjectResult with an error message.
